title: The Wolf and the Dog

plan.english: A wolf was hungry. Then he saw a dog and said to him: "You are satisfied. How do you live?" "I guard the cow-stall. Follow me!" Then he followed him. Then he caught sight of a mark on the dog's neck. "What is on your neck?" "At night they put a cord on my neck." "Dog, you are not free! I do not follow you." Then the wolf left. If he is hungry, the free one lives; he who is not free does not live.

title: The Eagle, the Bird and the Great Fish

plan.english: An eagle and a bird sat on a stone. Then the eagle saw a large fish in the water. She said to him: "Eagle, do not seize the fish! He is strong." "I am strong!" Then he seized the fish. Then it pulled the eagle down into the water, and the eagle sank. He who does not hear his friend's word sinks.

title: The Mouse and the Bear

plan.english: A bear seized a mouse. The mouse said: "Let me go! I am weak and you are strong. If you let me go, I will free you." The bear let him go. Then men threw a cord around the bear. The bear cried out. The mouse, hearing him, ran to him and cut the cord. "You freed me!" The weak frees the strong.

title: The Dog, the Snake and the Horse

plan.english: In winter a snake grew cold. A dog caught sight of the snake. A horse said to the dog: "Do not warm the snake! The snake kills." "He is weak, and I am strong. I will put him by the fire." Then the dog put the snake by the fire. The snake grew warm. Then it killed him. "Horse, I did not hear you." Whoever warms a snake dies.

title: The Wolf and the Ram

plan.english: A wolf seized a ram. The ram said to him: "I am thirsty. Let me go, that I may drink water. Then eat me!" The wolf let him go. The ram drank the water. Then he fled to the shepherd. The shepherd killed the wolf. Whoever lets the ram go does not eat.

title: The Sheep, the Dog and the Wolf

plan.english: A sheep lived in the field, and a dog guarded her. A wolf caught sight of her. He said to her: "Sheep, the dog is not your friend. Drive him away, and I will be your friend." Then she drove him away. Then she said: "Where is he?" Then he devoured her. The one who drives the dog away feeds the wolf.

title: The Bird, the Snake and the Eagle

plan.english: A bird's nest was in the tree. Then a snake crept toward the nest. She grew afraid and said: "Eagle, listen to me! A snake is creeping toward my nest!" The eagle, hearing her, came and seized the snake. The friend hears the one who cries out.

title: The Dog in the Cow-Stall

plan.english: A dog lay on the barley. Then the cattle came to the cow-stall. They said to him: "Dog, you do not eat the barley. Give us the barley!" "Go away, cattle! I do not give you the barley." Then they pushed him out and ate up the barley. He who does not eat and does not give is pushed out.

title: The Fish and the Drying Water

plan.english: A fish and a sheatfish lived in the water. Then the sun dried the water. The fish said to him: "Sheatfish, the water is gone. Let us go to the sea!" "I dwell in my own water." Then the fish swam to the sea. And the sheatfish died. If the water is gone, he who dwells dies.

title: The Two He-Goats at the Crossing

plan.english: Two he-goats came to a crossing. The crossing was one. One of the two said: "He-goat, go away!" "You go away!" Then the two pushed. Then both fell into the water. If a strong one pushes a strong one, the two fall.

title: The Horse Who Called the Man

plan.english: A bear pushed a horse out of the field. The horse went to a man. "Man, the bear is driving me out! Drive him out." The man said: "Take the yoke, and I will drive him out." Then the horse took the yoke. The man harnessed him and drove the bear out. "Let me go!" "I will not let you go." Whoever goes to the man carries the yoke.

title: The She-Wolf and the Ram at the Water

plan.english: A she-wolf drank water above, and a ram drank below. She said to him: "You drink my water!" "The water goes from you to me." "Last year you drank it." "Last year I did not live." "Then your father drank my water." Then she devoured him. A hungry wolf has a word.

title: The Dog and the Fish in the Water

plan.english: A dog carrying a fish came to the water. Then he looked at a dog in the water. "Give me your fish!" Then he cried out. Then it slipped from the mouth into the water, and the water transported it off. Whoever seeks much, his own vanishes.

title: The Mouse Who Would Drink the Sea

plan.english: A mouse came to the sea and said: "Sea, I will drink you!" An eagle said: "Do not drink the sea! The sea is great." He did not hear the eagle. He drank it and filled himself. Then he burst. Whoever does not know his own strength bursts.

title: The Bear, the Horse and the Apples

plan.english: A bear stood under a tree, and a horse lay near. The bear pushed it. Then the apples fell. The horse ate up the apples. The bear said: "Horse, I work, and you eat!" "Push the tree again!" Then the bear grew tired, and the horse became sated. He who works does not eat.

title: The Eagle and the Swift Horses

plan.english: Swift horses ran in the field. The eagle, seeing them, said to them: "Horses, you go on the earth, and I go above." "Eagle, come down and run!" Then he came down and did not run. He who is great in the sky is not great on the earth.

title: The Dog and the Gift of the Thief

plan.english: The cattle stood in the cow-stall, and the dog guarded them. At night a thief came to the cow-stall. Then he gave him a gift. The thief said: "Eat it, and do not speak!" "Thief, your gift is not a gift. I will cry out." Then the dog cried out. Men came, and the thief fled. A thief's gift is not a gift.

title: The Bear Chased the Sheep and Father Sky Heard

plan.english: A bear drove a sheep in the field. She fled and prayed: "Father Sky, listen to me! May it rain!" Then it rained. The water filled the field. The bear left, and she drank the water. Sky hears the one who prays.

title: The Bird on the Aurochs

plan.english: An aurochs stood under a tree. A bird sat down on him and said: "Aurochs, do you see me? Shall I go away?" "I do not see you. I did not hear you, and I will not hear you." The strong does not notice the weak.

title: The Wolf in the Sheep's Wool

plan.english: A wolf wore wool and went into the field. The shepherd, catching sight of him, said: "The sheep is good! At night I will cook her." Then the shepherd killed him and cooked him. Whoever wears that wool, the shepherd kills.

title: The Dog, the Horse and the Fire

plan.english: In winter a dog lay near the fire, and a horse stood outside. The horse said to him: "I tremble. Seat me by the fire!" "The fire is mine. Stand outside!" In the warm weather the dog was thirsty, and the horse stood in the water. "Give me water!" "The water is mine. Stand outside!" He who does not give in winter, to him they do not give in the warm weather.

title: The Four Cattle and the Serpent

plan.english: Four cattle stood under a tree. A serpent looked at them. "Cattle, give me one of you!" "We stand, and we do not give you one." Then he left. Then one went from the cattle to the water. Then the serpent grasped him and devoured him. The serpent kills the one who leaves the cattle.

title: The Goat and the Wolf's Words

plan.english: A goat stood on a stone. The wolf, catching sight of him, said: "Goat, go down to the field! It is good." "You do not look at it. You look at me." Then the wolf left. His word is good, and his heart is hungry.

title: The Eagle's Famous Name

plan.english: A serpent devoured an aurochs. Then the eagle slew the serpent. A bird said to him: "Eagle, how is your name famous?" "I slew him." Whoever slays the serpent, his fame is imperishable.

title: The Wolf, the Piglet and the Pledge

plan.english: The wolf gave the piglet a pledge: "I will not eat you." The piglet said: "I am confident." Then the wolf broke the pledge and devoured him. If he is hungry, his pledge breaks.

title: The Serpent, the Piglet and the Dawn

plan.english: It was getting dark. At night a serpent sought a piglet. The piglet prayed: "Dawn, daughter of Sky, come! Show the serpent to the dog!" Then it grew bright. The dog, catching sight of the serpent, cried out, and the serpent fled. Whoever goes by night flees at dawn.

title: The Old Horse and Mother Earth

plan.english: A horse grew tired and lay down. "Mother Earth, take me! I carried the wheel of the sun." Then the earth took him. The earth is the mother of mortals.

title: The Snake and the Horse at the Water

plan.english: A snake came to the water and said to the horse: "Transport me through the water!" "Snake, I fear you." "I will not kill you. If I kill you, I shall die." Then the horse transported him. Then the snake killed him, and the two died. Whoever kills his carrier dies.

title: The Goat, the Horse and the Ice

plan.english: In winter ice covered the water. A goat walked on the ice. Then a horse came to it. The goat said to him: "Horse, do not go on the ice! It is not strong." "Goat, I am strong, and it is strong." Then he went on it. The ice split, and the horse fell into the water. The ice holds the weak, but under the strong it splits.

title: The Bird Who Would Be an Eagle

plan.english: An eagle seized a sheep and went up. The bird saw this. "I will indeed seize a ram!" Then she took it. Then the wool held her, and the shepherd caught her. Then she said: "I am not an eagle!" She who is not an eagle, the shepherd seizes.

title: The Mouse in the Wolf's Mouth

plan.english: A wolf grasped a mouse. The mouse said: "Let me go! If I grow up, I shall be great, and you will eat me up." "Mouse, you are in my mouth, and you are dear to me. I do not know the great one." Then he devoured him. The one in the wolf's mouth is dear; the great one is not.

title: The Boat and the Fish

plan.english: A boat transported men on the sea. The fish saw her. She said to him: "Fish, I transport men, and you do not transport them." "Boat, the water carries you and me." The water carries the carrier.

title: The Horse Who Feared the Cord

plan.english: A cord lay on the way. The horse looked at it and was afraid. He said: "A snake!" and fled. Then a snake lay on the way. The horse did not catch sight of the snake and came upon it. Then the snake killed him. He who trembles at a cord does not see the snake.

title: The Dog's Promise

plan.english: A wolf said to the dog: "Give me a piglet!" "Wolf, come to the cow-stall at night, and I will give you a piglet." Then he came to the cow-stall. Then the dog cried out. Men came, and he fled. A word draws the wolf into the stall.

title: The Bear's Share

plan.english: A bear, a wolf and an eagle grasped a large fish. The bear said: "It is mine. I am strong." The wolf and the eagle said: "You are strong, and we two are weak." Then the two left. The strong takes, and the weak go hungry.

title: The Two Friends and the Bear

plan.english: Two friends were going along the way. A bear came to them. One of the two climbed into a tree, and the friend lay down. The bear came near and went away. Then one of the two came down. "What did the bear say to you?" "He said to me: 'Do not follow him.'" A friend who leaves you is not a friend.

title: The She-Wolf and the Aurochs's Trick

plan.english: A she-wolf looked at an aurochs at the water. "Aurochs, I shall eat you up!" "Come, she-wolf! I am standing." Then she ran at him. He went aside, and she slipped into the water. "Drink it, she-wolf!" He who runs and does not look slips.

title: The Sheep and Her Daughter

plan.english: A sheep said to her daughter: "Daughter, do not go to the water at night! A she-wolf is standing there." The daughter did not hear her own mother. She went to it. The she-wolf seized her. Then the daughter said: "Mother, listen to me!" Then the she-wolf devoured her. The mother's word frees the daughter who hears it.

title: The Bear Who Woke in Spring

plan.english: In winter a bear was lying down. Then the ice melted. A bird said in the tree: "Wake up! The ice is melting." Then he woke and said: "I am hungry." Then he stood up. When the ice melts, the bear wakes.

title: The Wheel, the Yoke and the Horses

plan.english: Two horses pulled the wheel. The wheel said: "I carry the man." The horse said: "I pull you." The yoke said: "I join the two." Then the man let the two horses go. Then the wheel stood still. If the horse does not pull, the wheel stands.
